messages.subject: Wallace v2 is ready for beta testing!
parts:
Wallace v2 is ready for beta testing! This will be the last round of testing before release to CRAN.
For install instructions and information on bug reporting, check out Beta Testing. For a tutorial on using this version and a worked example,  check out the Vignette. 
Thanks!
